summary: FD_TC_057_No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 51, damage during flight operations), APPR
title: No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 51, damage during flight operations), APPR
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours because of delay code 51 (bird strike found, so the aircraft needs a damage inspection; uncontrollable). The customer chooses not to travel and stays at the origin. Checks that No Travel Origin plus an uncontrollable damage code returns Not Eligible under APPR, with a full ticket refund entitlement.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC044: one adult passenger, one AC domestic leg YUL?YYZ, AC 460, May 28, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:20 (260 min late). Actual arrival 16:25 (265 min late). No cancellation code. First arrival delay code 51 (DF). First departure delay code 51 (DF). Passenger not boarded and coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted.
